use.flag: Build and install oo7-daemon, the org.freedesktop.secrets server that replaces gnome-base/gnome-keyring
Use dev-libs/openssl for cryptography instead of the pure-Rust implementation
Build and install pam_oo7.so, which unlocks the oo7-daemon login keyring at login
Build and install oo7-portal, the org.freedesktop.impl.portal.Secret backend for sys-apps/xdg-desktop-portal
